answer: In PoA, every bonded identity is a vertex in an evidence graph, so coordinated equivocation by k identities creates O(k^2) correlated conflicts and triggers quadratic slashing across their escrows. A controller cannot cheaply forge many agents: once correlation is proven, detection applies an exponential multiplier to aggregate capital loss, while asymmetric depreciation makes recovered collateral worth less. A cedar-backed audit trail preserves the evidence for deterministic adjudication.
